meaning.en: Brihaspati said
meaning.hi: बृहस्पति ने कहा

meaning.en: to Yajnavalkya
meaning.hi: याज्ञवल्क्य से

meaning.en: Kurukshetra, the sacred field
meaning.hi: कुरुक्षेत्र

meaning.en: the gods' own sacrificial ground
meaning.hi: देवताओं का यज्ञस्थान

meaning.en: the resting place of the divine reality for all beings
meaning.hi: सभी प्राणियों के लिए ब्रह्म का निवासस्थान

meaning.en: truly, the Unforsaken Place
meaning.hi: सच में, अविमुक्त

meaning.en: therefore, wherever one goes
meaning.hi: इसलिए, जहाँ कहीं भी जाए

meaning.en: should regard that very place
meaning.hi: उसी को मानना चाहिए

meaning.en: as that very Unforsaken Place
meaning.hi: वही अविमुक्त है

meaning.en: this indeed is Kurukshetra
meaning.hi: यही सच में कुरुक्षेत्र है

verification.notes: Word-by-word gloss read against the verse's own Sanskrit; each entry is a plain-language meaning, not a grammatical parse.

meaning.en: right here, indeed
meaning.hi: यहाँ ही, निश्चय ही

meaning.en: when a creature's life-breaths are departing
meaning.hi: जब प्राणी के प्राण निकल रहे हों

meaning.en: Rudra, the fierce transformative aspect of the divine
meaning.hi: रुद्र

meaning.en: reveals the liberating, ferrying reality
meaning.hi: तारण करने वाला ब्रह्म प्रकट करते हैं

meaning.en: by which, becoming deathless
meaning.hi: जिससे अमर होकर

meaning.en: one attains liberation
meaning.hi: मोक्ष प्राप्त करता है

meaning.en: therefore one should devotedly hold to the Unforsaken Place
meaning.hi: इसलिए अविमुक्त की ही सेवा करनी चाहिए

meaning.en: one should never abandon the Unforsaken Place
meaning.hi: अविमुक्त को कभी न त्यागे

meaning.en: this much is certain, Yajnavalkya said
meaning.hi: यही निश्चित है, याज्ञवल्क्य ने कहा

verification.notes: Word-by-word gloss read against the verse's own Sanskrit; each entry is a plain-language meaning, not a grammatical parse.

meaning.en: then, indeed, him
meaning.hi: तब, निश्चय ही, उनसे

meaning.en: Atri asked
meaning.hi: अत्रि ने पूछा

meaning.en: Yajnavalkya
meaning.hi: याज्ञवल्क्य से

meaning.en: this self that is infinite and beyond all form
meaning.hi: यह जो आत्मा अनंत और निराकार है

meaning.en: how am I to come to know it?
meaning.hi: उसे मैं कैसे जानूँ?

verification.notes: Word-by-word gloss read against the verse's own Sanskrit; each entry is a plain-language meaning, not a grammatical parse.

meaning.en: Yajnavalkya then replied
meaning.hi: याज्ञवल्क्य ने तब उत्तर दिया

meaning.en: that self should be approached through the Unforsaken Place
meaning.hi: उसकी उपासना अविमुक्त के माध्यम से करनी चाहिए

meaning.en: that infinite, formless self
meaning.hi: वह अनंत, निराकार आत्मा

meaning.en: for it has taken its stand there, in the Unforsaken Place
meaning.hi: क्योंकि वह वहीं स्थिर होकर बसी है

verification.notes: Word-by-word gloss read against the verse's own Sanskrit; each entry is a plain-language meaning, not a grammatical parse.

meaning.en: where exactly does the Unforsaken Place stand established?
meaning.hi: यह अविमुक्त ठीक कहाँ स्थापित है?

meaning.en: in the Varana river
meaning.hi: वरणा नदी में

meaning.en: and in the Nashi river
meaning.hi: और नाशी नदी में

meaning.en: it stands established between them
meaning.hi: इनके बीच स्थापित है

verification.notes: Word-by-word gloss read against the verse's own Sanskrit; each entry is a plain-language meaning, not a grammatical parse.

meaning.en: what exactly is Varana?
meaning.hi: वरणा असल में क्या है?

meaning.en: and what exactly is Nashi?
meaning.hi: और नाशी असल में क्या है?

meaning.en: all the faults created by the senses
meaning.hi: इन्द्रियों द्वारा उत्पन्न सभी दोष

meaning.en: because it holds back, restrains
meaning.hi: क्योंकि यह रोकती है

meaning.en: therefore it is called Varana
meaning.hi: इसलिए इसे वरणा कहते हैं

verification.notes: Word-by-word gloss read against the verse's own Sanskrit; each entry is a plain-language meaning, not a grammatical parse.

meaning.en: all the wrongdoing created by the senses
meaning.hi: इन्द्रियों द्वारा किए गए सभी पाप

meaning.en: because it destroys
meaning.hi: क्योंकि यह नष्ट कर देती है

meaning.en: therefore it is called Nashi
meaning.hi: इसलिए इसे नाशी कहते हैं

verification.notes: Word-by-word gloss read against the verse's own Sanskrit; each entry is a plain-language meaning, not a grammatical parse.

words.sanskrit: katamaṁ cha asya sthānaṁ bhavati iti

meaning.en: and where exactly is its true seat?
meaning.hi: और इसका असली स्थान कहाँ है?

meaning.en: the junction of the eyebrows and the nose
meaning.hi: भौंहों और नासिका का संधि-स्थान

words.sanskrit: saḥ eṣaḥ dyauḥ lokasya parasya cha sandhiḥ bhavati iti

meaning.en: that very junction is the meeting place of the heavenly world and this one
meaning.hi: यही संधि स्वर्गलोक और इस लोक का मिलन-स्थान है

words.sanskrit: etad vai sandhiṁ sandhyāṁ brahmavidaḥ upāsate iti

meaning.en: knowers of the ultimate reality worship this junction as the meeting-time of dusk
meaning.hi: ब्रह्मवेत्ता इस संधि को संध्या के रूप में उपासते हैं

meaning.en: so one should hold the Unforsaken Place in devotion
meaning.hi: इसलिए अविमुक्त की उपासना करनी चाहिए

meaning.en: this reveals the knowledge of the Unforsaken Place
meaning.hi: यही अविमुक्त के ज्ञान को उजागर करता है

words.sanskrit: yaḥ vai etad evaṁ veda iti

meaning.en: to whoever comes to know it in just this way
meaning.hi: जो इसे इस प्रकार जानता है, उसके लिए

verification.notes: Word-by-word gloss read against the verse's own Sanskrit; each entry is a plain-language meaning, not a grammatical parse.

meaning.en: then the students who had completed disciplined study asked him
meaning.hi: तब ब्रह्मचारियों ने उनसे पूछा

meaning.en: by chanting what
meaning.hi: किसका जप करके

meaning.en: tell us how to attain deathlessness
meaning.hi: हमें बताइए, अमरत्व कैसे प्राप्त हो

verification.notes: Word-by-word gloss read against the verse's own Sanskrit; each entry is a plain-language meaning, not a grammatical parse.

meaning.en: Yajnavalkya replied
meaning.hi: याज्ञवल्क्य ने उत्तर दिया

meaning.en: through the Shatarudriya, the hymn of Rudra's hundred names
meaning.hi: शतरुद्रीय के माध्यम से

words.sanskrit: etāni eva ha vai amṛtasya nāmāni

meaning.en: these very names are, in truth, the names of the deathless
meaning.hi: ये नाम सच में अमरत्व के ही नाम हैं

verification.notes: Word-by-word gloss read against the verse's own Sanskrit; each entry is a plain-language meaning, not a grammatical parse.

words.sanskrit: etaiḥ ha vai amṛtaḥ bhavati iti

meaning.en: through these, a person becomes deathless
meaning.hi: इनके द्वारा व्यक्ति अमर हो जाता है

meaning.en: this much is certain, Yajnavalkya said
meaning.hi: यही निश्चित है, याज्ञवल्क्य ने कहा

verification.notes: Word-by-word gloss read against the verse's own Sanskrit; each entry is a plain-language meaning, not a grammatical parse.

meaning.en: Janaka, king of Videha
meaning.hi: विदेह के राजा जनक

meaning.en: approached Yajnavalkya and said
meaning.hi: याज्ञवल्क्य के पास आकर कहा

meaning.en: my lord, teach me about renunciation
meaning.hi: हे भगवन्, मुझे संन्यास सिखाइए

meaning.en: after finishing disciplined study, one should become a householder
meaning.hi: ब्रह्मचर्य पूरा करके गृहस्थ बने

meaning.en: having been a householder, one should go to the forest
meaning.hi: गृहस्थ होकर वनवासी बने

meaning.en: having lived in the forest, one should become a wandering renunciant
meaning.hi: वनवासी होकर प्रव्रजित हो

words.sanskrit: yadi vā itarathā brahmacharyād eva pravrajet gṛhād vā vanād vā

meaning.en: or else, one may renounce directly from disciplined study, from household life, or from the forest
meaning.hi: अथवा ब्रह्मचर्य, गृहस्थ या वन से सीधे प्रव्रजित हो

verification.notes: Word-by-word gloss read against the verse's own Sanskrit; each entry is a plain-language meaning, not a grammatical parse.

words.sanskrit: atha punaḥ avratī vā vratī vā

meaning.en: whether one has kept every vow or not
meaning.hi: व्रती हो या अव्रती

meaning.en: whether one has completed formal study or not
meaning.hi: स्नातक हो या न हो

meaning.en: or whether one has let the sacred fire go out
meaning.hi: या पवित्र अग्नि बुझने दी हो

meaning.en: on whatever day true detachment arises
meaning.hi: जिस दिन वैराग्य जागे

meaning.en: that very day one should renounce
meaning.hi: उसी दिन प्रव्रजित हो

meaning.en: some hold that only the Prajapatya offering need be performed
meaning.hi: कुछ केवल प्राजापत्य हवन करते हैं

words.sanskrit: na tathā kuryāt āgneyīm eva kuryāt

meaning.en: others say this is not right, and the fire-offering to Agni should be performed
meaning.hi: दूसरे कहते हैं यह ठीक नहीं, अग्नि-हवन ही करना चाहिए

verification.notes: Word-by-word gloss read against the verse's own Sanskrit; each entry is a plain-language meaning, not a grammatical parse.

meaning.en: fire, indeed, is the life-breath
meaning.hi: अग्नि वास्तव में प्राण है

meaning.en: so it is this very life-breath that performs that offering
meaning.hi: इसलिए यही प्राण उस हवन को करता है

verification.notes: Word-by-word gloss read against the verse's own Sanskrit; each entry is a plain-language meaning, not a grammatical parse.

meaning.en: one should instead perform the offering to the three elements
meaning.hi: व्यक्ति को त्रैधात्वीय हवन ही करना चाहिए

meaning.en: for these very three are the elements
meaning.hi: यही तीनों तत्व हैं

words.sanskrit: yad uta sattvam rajaḥ tamaḥ iti

meaning.en: namely, goodness, restless activity, and inertia
meaning.hi: अर्थात् सत्त्व, रजस और तमस

verification.notes: Word-by-word gloss read against the verse's own Sanskrit; each entry is a plain-language meaning, not a grammatical parse.

meaning.en: this is your true origin, O priests
meaning.hi: यह तुम्हारा सच्चा मूल है, हे ऋत्विजो

meaning.en: from which, once born, you shone forth from the life-breath itself
meaning.hi: जिससे जन्म लेकर तुम प्राण से प्रकट हुए

meaning.en: knowing that breath, O fire, rise up
meaning.hi: उस प्राण को जानकर, हे अग्नि, ऊपर उठो

meaning.en: and let our wealth increase
meaning.hi: और हमारा धन बढ़ाओ

meaning.en: with this mantra, one should draw in the fire's presence through breath
meaning.hi: इस मंत्र से अग्नि को प्राण से भीतर खींचे

verification.notes: Word-by-word gloss read against the verse's own Sanskrit; each entry is a plain-language meaning, not a grammatical parse.

meaning.en: this indeed is fire's true origin
meaning.hi: यही सच में अग्नि का मूल है

meaning.en: which is the life-breath
meaning.hi: जो प्राण है

meaning.en: go now to the breath, all glory to it
meaning.hi: अब प्राण की ओर जाओ, उसकी जय हो

meaning.en: this is exactly what has been declared
meaning.hi: यही स्पष्ट रूप से घोषित किया गया

verification.notes: Word-by-word gloss read against the verse's own Sanskrit; each entry is a plain-language meaning, not a grammatical parse.

meaning.en: one may bring fire from the village
meaning.hi: गाँव से अग्नि लाकर

meaning.en: and let it mingle, through smell, with the fire burning before
meaning.hi: पहले की अग्नि से गंध द्वारा मिला दे

verification.notes: Word-by-word gloss read against the verse's own Sanskrit; each entry is a plain-language meaning, not a grammatical parse.

meaning.en: if a person cannot find fire at all
meaning.hi: यदि अग्नि बिल्कुल न मिले

meaning.en: the offering should be made into water instead
meaning.hi: जल में हवन करे

meaning.en: for all the waters are, in truth, every deity
meaning.hi: सभी जल, सच में, हर देवता हैं

meaning.en: I offer to every deity, saying svaha
meaning.hi: मैं हर देवता को स्वाहा कहते हुए अर्पित करता हूँ

meaning.en: having offered, one should then take a sip with butter and the offered food
meaning.hi: हवन के बाद घृत और हवि सहित एक घूँट ले

meaning.en: this is the untroubled mantra of liberation
meaning.hi: यही मुक्ति का निर्दोष मंत्र है

meaning.en: this is the ultimate reality, and this is what should be meditated upon
meaning.hi: यही ब्रह्म है, इसी की उपासना करनी चाहिए

verification.notes: Word-by-word gloss read against the verse's own Sanskrit; each entry is a plain-language meaning, not a grammatical parse.

meaning.en: Atri asked Yajnavalkya
meaning.hi: अत्रि ने याज्ञवल्क्य से पूछा

meaning.en: how can one who wears no sacred thread truly be a brahmin?
meaning.hi: यज्ञोपवीत रहित व्यक्ति ब्राह्मण कैसे हो सकता है?

meaning.en: this very thing is that person's sacred thread
meaning.hi: यही उसका यज्ञोपवीत है

meaning.en: which is the self
meaning.hi: जो आत्मा है

meaning.en: known after sipping and touching water in purification
meaning.hi: जल का आचमन कर, छूकर जानी गई

meaning.en: this is the way laid down for wanderers
meaning.hi: यही भ्रमणशील व्यक्तियों के लिए विधि है

words.sanskrit: vīrādhvāne vā anāśake vā apāṁ praveśe vā agnipraveśe vā mahāprasthāne vā

meaning.en: whether by the hero's road, by fasting to the end, by entering water, by entering fire, or by the great final journey
meaning.hi: वीर के मार्ग से, उपवास से, जल-प्रवेश से, अग्नि-प्रवेश से, या महाप्रस्थान से

verification.notes: Word-by-word gloss read against the verse's own Sanskrit; each entry is a plain-language meaning, not a grammatical parse.

meaning.en: such a wanderer then
meaning.hi: ऐसा भ्रमणशील व्यक्ति फिर

meaning.en: goes about in plain, undyed clothing, shaved-headed, owning nothing
meaning.hi: सादे वस्त्र, मुण्डित सिर, बिना संग्रह के

meaning.en: pure, harming no one, living on alms alone
meaning.hi: शुद्ध, अहिंसक, भिक्षा पर जीता हुआ

meaning.en: and in this way comes to belong fully to the ultimate reality
meaning.hi: और इस तरह पूर्ण रूप से ब्रह्ममय हो जाता है

words.sanskrit: yadi āturaḥ syāt manasā vāchā sannyaset

meaning.en: if seriously ill, one may renounce through mind and speech alone
meaning.hi: यदि रोगी हो तो मन और वाणी से संन्यास ले

meaning.en: this is the path travelled by those who truly know the ultimate reality
meaning.hi: यही मार्ग ब्रह्मवेत्ताओं द्वारा चला गया है

meaning.en: by this a renunciant becomes a knower of the ultimate reality
meaning.hi: इससे संन्यासी ब्रह्मवेत्ता बनता है

verification.notes: Word-by-word gloss read against the verse's own Sanskrit; each entry is a plain-language meaning, not a grammatical parse.

meaning.en: among these, the great renunciants called paramahamsas
meaning.hi: इनमें से, परमहंस कहे जाने वाले

words.sanskrit: Samvartaka Āruṇi Śvetaketu Durvāsaḥ Ṛbhu Nidāgha Jaḍabharata Dattātreya Raivataka prabhṛtayaḥ

meaning.en: Samvartaka, Aruni, Shvetaketu, Durvasa, Ribhu, Nidagha, Jada Bharata, Dattatreya, Raivataka, and others like them
meaning.hi: संवर्तक, आरुणि, श्वेतकेतु, दुर्वासा, ऋभु, निदाघ, जड भरत, दत्तात्रेय, रैवतक आदि

meaning.en: carrying no outward sign, their conduct fitting no expected pattern
meaning.hi: अव्यक्त चिह्न, अव्यक्त आचरण वाले

meaning.en: not mad, yet sometimes acting as though they were
meaning.hi: पागल नहीं, पर कभी-कभी पागल जैसे व्यवहार करते

words.sanskrit: tridaṇḍaṁ kamaṇḍaluṁ śikyaṁ pātraṁ jalapavitraṁ śikhāṁ yajñopavītaṁ cha

meaning.en: the triple staff, water pot, carrying-sling, bowl, water-purifier, topknot, and sacred thread
meaning.hi: त्रिदण्ड, कमण्डलु, झोली, पात्र, जलपवित्र, शिखा और यज्ञोपवीत

words.sanskrit: ityetat sarvaṁ bhūḥ svāhā iti apsu parityajya

meaning.en: setting all this aside, saying this earth and water are that offering
meaning.hi: इन सबको त्यागकर, कहते हुए कि यह पृथ्वी और जल ही अर्पण है

meaning.en: they seek only the self
meaning.hi: वे केवल आत्मा की खोज करते हैं

verification.notes: Word-by-word gloss read against the verse's own Sanskrit; each entry is a plain-language meaning, not a grammatical parse.

meaning.en: one who wears only the form nature gave at birth
meaning.hi: जो प्रकृति-प्रदत्त रूप ही धारण किए रहता है

meaning.en: free of every knot and every possession
meaning.hi: हर बंधन और संपत्ति से मुक्त

meaning.en: fully devoted to the path to the ultimate reality, of a clean mind
meaning.hi: ब्रह्म-मार्ग को समर्पित, स्वच्छ मन वाला

words.sanskrit: prāṇasandhāraṇārthaṁ yathoktakāle vimuktaḥ bhaikṣam ācharan udarapātreṇa

meaning.en: only to sustain the breath, at the proper time, freely taking alms in cupped hands as a bowl
meaning.hi: प्राण बनाए रखने हेतु, उचित समय पर, हथेलियों को पात्र बनाकर भिक्षा लेता हुआ

meaning.en: meeting both plenty and lack with the same evenness
meaning.hi: लाभ और अलाभ में समान भाव रखते हुए

words.sanskrit: śūnyāgāra devagṛha tṛṇakūṭa valmīka vṛkṣamūla kulālaśālā agnihotragṛha nadīpulina girikuhara kandara koṭara nirjhara sthaṇḍileṣu aniketavāsī

meaning.en: dwelling without a fixed home in an empty house, temple, straw-heap, anthill, tree root, potter's shed, fire-hut, riverbank, sandbank, mountain cave, hollow, waterfall, or bare ground
meaning.hi: खाली घर, मंदिर, पुआल, बाँबी, वृक्ष-जड़, कुम्हारशाला, अग्निगृह, नदी-तट, गिरि-गुहा, झरने या खुली भूमि में बिना स्थिर घर के रहता हुआ

meaning.en: whose effort carries no trace of mine, wholly given to bright contemplation, established in the knowledge of the self, focused on uprooting unwholesome action
meaning.hi: जिसके प्रयास में ममत्व नहीं, उज्ज्वल ध्यान में लीन, आत्मज्ञान में स्थिर, अशुभ कर्मों को जड़ से मिटाने में तत्पर

meaning.en: such a one, by renunciation, lets go of the body
meaning.hi: ऐसा व्यक्ति संन्यास से देह का त्याग करता है

words.sanskrit: sa paramahaṁsaḥ nāma paramahaṁsaḥ nāma iti

meaning.en: that one is called a paramahamsa, that one is called a paramahamsa
meaning.hi: ऐसे व्यक्ति को परमहंस कहा जाता है, परमहंस कहा जाता है

verification.notes: Word-by-word gloss read against the verse's own Sanskrit; each entry is a plain-language meaning, not a grammatical parse.
